messages:
maya: Heads up — after we pushed the keystore egress tweak to ap-southeast-2 we're missing audit lines and the GPU warm pool is jittering. autoscaler fallback kicked to larger instances. ops-bot raised an alert.
ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-egress -> audit_shipper 503 / route-fail; affected: gpu-warm-pool-ap-southeast-2; callout: keystore-proxy timeouts.
devin: @maya can you paste the NACL / firewall change?
maya: I pushed the change, I thought I scoped to the keystore subnet but I accidentally used a 10.0.0.0/8 deny instead of 10.4.0.0/16.
maya: snippet i applied:
```diff
- egress: allow 0.0.0.0/0:443 -> keystore-endpoint
+ egress: deny 10.0.0.0/8:443
```
kenji: Oof. If audit_shipper or the SIEM collectors route via the NAT gateway or privatelink that deny will drop them. Are KMS grants using aws:SourceIp?
elena: Yes — ephemeral KMS grants currently have an aws:SourceIp condition until we finalize the privatelink rollout. That combined with dropped egress means KMS sign/decrypt fails and nodes can't finish onboarding.
devin: Rollback approved. @maya can you revert the NACL entry and reopen the outbound to the keystore endpoints for the keystore subnet?
maya: Doing rollback now. Command I'm running: `aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0abc --rule-number 100 --egress --cidr-block 10.0.0.0/8 --rule-action allow --protocol tcp --port-range From=443,To=443`
ops-bot: [RUN] rollback-job-6823456795 started by maya — replacing NACL entry.
ops-bot: [INFO] rollback-job-6823456795 completed — new state: egress allow restored for 10.4.0.0/16 -> keystore endpoints.
kenji: After rollback, restart keystore-proxy pods so they reestablish persistent connections to the SIEM. `kubectl rollout restart ds/keystore-proxy -n infra`
maya: restarted the daemonset, pods coming up. Keystore proxy logs show successful handshakes again.
elena: We still saw ~12 minutes of missing audit events and some GPU nodes evicted back to warm pool, autoscaler rebalanced. Cost note: because some traffic spilled to our cross-region backup SIEM ingestion, telemetry charge estimate ~ $2.1k/day until fully backfilled.
devin: Unpleasant but acceptable short-term. Action items: 1) add a preflight egress test for keystore/SIEM during NACL changes, 2) add a fallback KMS grant without aws:SourceIp for 10m during rollouts, 3) add ownership tag on NACL rules to prevent broad CIDR mistakes.
kenji: I'll add the preflight check to our infra CI: curl from a short-lived pod to the SIEM collector and validate 200 + a simple keystore decrypt test.
maya: I'll open the rollback PR with guardrails and the runbook notes.
elena: Also suggest we add audit-sampling markers so we can detect dropped spans sooner (alert when sampling percent deviates >5%).
devin: Create a short post-incident thread in incidents/ if anything else shows up. For now: thumbs up and thanks to everyone who jumped in. :thumbsup:
maya: Will file followups: runbook + PR + cost ticket for telemetry overage.
kenji: +1 on postmortem/lessons.
ops-bot: [METRIC] audit_shipper_error_rate returned to baseline at 6823456832.
maya: closing the loop — keeping the temporary mitigations but scheduling a safer privatelink cutover next week.
